from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialLineItem(BaseModel):
    """A specific financial line item extracted from a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The full name of the company this report belongs to")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., Q1 2024)")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the financial item or account")
    value: str | None = Field(description="The reported value, preserving original formatting (e.g. '7,941,067.96' or '-')")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the extracted data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_line_items: list[FinancialLineItem]
